title: F1 2025 Abu Dhabi GP Special Livery Boat
description: This is a Formula 1 2025 texturepack by AdamixGaming, NotGatoz and Jerpix | required OptiFine!!!
body:
Mercedes Safety Car

    all boat with chest (without bamboo raft)


Aston Martin Safety Car

    Bamboo Chest Raft

No command is needed to spawn the Safety Car


oak_boat

    Ferrari 44,16

spruce_boat

    VCARB 30,6
    Haas 31,87 (if old version)

birch_boat

    Alpine 10,43

jungle_boat

    RedBull 1,22

acacia_boat

    Mclaren 4,81

dark_oak_boat

    MercedesAMG 63,12

cherry_boat

    Aston Martin 14,18

mangrove_boat

    Williams 55,23

bamboo_boat

    KICK Sauber 27,5

(if new version)
pale_oak

    HAAS 31,87
**How to specify**

    Fixed version only

/summon boat ~ ~ ~ {Type:"<oak | spruce | birch | jungle | acacia | dark_oak | cherry | mangrove | bamboo | pale_oak (if new version)>",CustomName:"\"<car number>_<soft | medium | hard | intermediate | wet>\""}

Example

/summon boat ~ ~ ~ {Type:"spruce",CustomName:"\"6_wet\""} (old version)
/summon pale_oak_boat ~ ~ ~ {CustomName:"\"31_hard\""} (new version)
